subject: Procurement & security intake: scheduling multi-stakeholder demo and kickoff
messages:
From: Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@cloudsync.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudsync.com
Date: 2025-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake & procurement kickoff (CloudSync x Redwood)

Hi Ben,

We're kicking off vendor intake for a potential initiative with Redwood. Procurement and security here want a short kickoff to outline the procurement steps, required artifacts (SOC2, retention, data flows) and a product demo so our engineering/security teams can validate fit.

Would next week work for a 45–60 minute session with:
- procurement (procurement@cloudsync.com)
- security engineer (legal & sec)
- infra/eng (Mike O'Neill)
- Redwood AE/SE to walk the stack

I've attached our RFP and network diagram for context (CloudSync_RFP.pdf, Network_Diagram.png). Our target timeline is to complete intake + security review by end of August if possible.

Thanks,
Mike O'Neill
Eng Manager, CloudSync Inc.
Attachments: CloudSync_RFP.pdf, Network_Diagram.png

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@cloudsync.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2025-08-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement kickoff (CloudSync x Redwood)

Mike — thanks for the RFP and the diagram. Happy to coordinate this. I'll bring AE/SE and loop in our security lead so we can cover both procurement checklist and the live demo items.

Suggested attendees from Redwood:
- Ben Carter (AE) — procurement & commercial lead
- Aditya Rao (Solutions Engineer) — demo & deployment patterns
- Marissa Cole (SE) — integration, accounts, demo runbook
- Evelyn Hart (Security) — controls, logging, data residency

Proposed slots (45 min):
1) Tue 2025-08-12 10:00–10:45 PT
2) Wed 2025-08-13 13:00–13:45 PT
3) Thu 2025-08-14 16:00–16:45 PT

If none work, tell us your availability and we will adjust. I'll attach a brief onboarding checklist that maps out procurement steps (I also linked the HubSpot record and Drive folder).

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Steps.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/HS-33472, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodCloudSyncOnboarding

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, Mike O'Neill <mike.oneill@cloudsync.com>
Date: 2025-08-04T13:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement kickoff (CloudSync x Redwood)

Ben / Aditya / Mike — quick note from the SE side. Any session time should include:
- 20 minute demo focused on latency (p99) and model privacy/segmentation
- 15 minute Q&A for infra/security (KV cache, KV encryption, network egress)
- 10 minute procurement checklist walkthrough (SLA, data retention, audit logs)

Two asks before the call to make the demo useful:
1) Access to an anonymized callflow or sample payloads so we can reproduce typical sequence lengths.
2) Confirmation of the AWS account number/region you expect to test against (or whether you'll run our hosted API).

Availability: Tue 10:00 PT and Thu 16:00 PT look good for me.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: 2025-08-06T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake & procurement kickoff (CloudSync x Redwood)

Ben / team — thanks, we can confirm Tue 2025-08-12 10:00–10:45 PT. I've asked procurement and legal to join; procurement@cloudsync.com will send the calendar invite from our side.

Quick notes/asks from procurement/legal:
- Please bring a SOC 2 summary and expected timeline for evidence collection.
- Record of data retention defaults and a high-level data flow diagram (we saw the network diagram, but please call out token logs / KV persistence).
- Please include any standard contract terms that typically require discussion (SLA credits, liability cap, data residency).

I'll forward the invite when procurement issues it. Looking forward to the demo and a short kickoff on process/timeline.

Best,
Mike O'Neill
Eng Manager, CloudSync Inc.
